description.value:
Named for the barge haulers of the Volga, and it means it. Techtronika built this for dock unions and reconstruction crews after the Unification War: cheap Neo-Soviet arms, tools for hands, and nothing else. It's the cheapest way to go metal that isn't a crime. *Treat as Expensive for availability.

Cost: 9,400eb (Expensive*)
Humanity Loss: 19 (6d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Base chrome (no HL): Discount Cyberaudio Suite and Neo-Soviet Cyberarm ×2 (replace the standard parts)
Chrome: Grip Foot ×2, Skin Weave, Tool Hand ×2

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Drop it on a character (as GM) to install it with Go Metal.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
